result.title: MVGraph: Benchmarking LVLMs on Evidence Composition across Multi-View Visual Graph
result.summary: We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---and design 29 diagnostic tasks with 64k instances to probe each one, along with golden intermediate representations for evaluating the intermediate process. Across 15 LVLMs, we reveal the difficulty of multi-graph reasoning and identify cross-view edge alignment and relation-level composition as prominent bottlenecks through stage-oriented diagnostics. Meanwhile, temporal constraints and increasing view counts expose further capability boundaries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/MVGraph.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MVGraph 基准，用 8k 道程序化构造、单视图不可解的多视图视觉图推理题，把多图推理拆成感知、对齐、组合、推理四类能力，并设计 29 项含黄金中间表示的诊断任务，在 15 个 LVLM 上定位跨视图边对齐与关系级组合为主要瓶颈。
AI.relevance_reason: 多视图证据对齐与组合、单视图不可解的设计以及中间过程诊断，直接关联 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选与证据组合收益问题，其分阶段诊断可供核查模型是否真正使用跨视图证据而非单视图旁路。
